title: Sinestream Signal Generator
text: Generate sinestream input signal for plant frequency response estimation, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Sample time (Ts)} sets Sample time; {Data Type} sets the floating point precision, {Excitation signal source}, {Frequencies}, {Amplitudes}, {Number of frequencies} sets the number of externally supplied frequencies, {Number of signal periods} sets the number of periods each sine wave is at maximum, {Waveform Type}, {Phase Shift} sets the phase shift of the wave, {Generate three-phase perturbation signal} and {Show frequency index port} enables frequency index port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: start/stop
ports.summary: Start and stop the signal generation scalar

params.name: Excitation signal source
params.values: Excitation signal source Block parameters (default) | External ports

params.name: Amplitudes
params.values: Amplitudes of injected perturbations 1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Number of frequencies
params.values: Number of externally supplied frequencies 3 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of signal periods
params.values: Number of periods each sine wave is at maximum amplitude 6 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Phase Shift
params.values: Phase shift of the wave 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Generate three-phase perturbation signal
params.values: Generate three-phase perturbation signal off (default) | on

params.name: Show frequency index port
params.values: Enable frequency index port off (default) | on
